subject: The truth about why I built this app for you
preview_text: This is my confession. Building SoulPlan wouldn't mean a thing without people like you. Let me explain why.
body_paragraphs: I have a confession to make. Honestly, building this app felt pointless for a long time. Just code on a screen. It only started to matter when I saw the first couple use it. That's the secret.

Seeing people like you actually plan dates, make memories, and sidestep that soul-crushing routine trap… that’s the whole point. It’s not about the features. It’s about the 230+ couples who told us it improved their relationship. You’re the reason this exists.

That’s why the Date History feature is my favorite. It’s your personal museum of ‘us.’ Every idea you saved, every date you logged—it’s proof you’re choosing each other. It turns random nights into a legacy of keeping the spark alive.

Open the app right now. Tap into your Date History. Scroll through your memories, then add one more. It’s the simplest way to show you care. P.S. The next date you log? Make it a surprise using the planner. Your partner will never see it coming.
